design.decision: Every extra trick bid compounds (about ×3 at 8 and ×4 at 10), and it applies on sets, so every bid becomes a high-stakes call.
design.opponent: Revealed at the first scoring; opponents defend hard to set big contracts, which now cost your team a fortune.
design.rationale: The Bid High build-around, with maximum bid tension both ways; its signature matches ub-contract-trick-xmult except for the amount, which is justified because at legendary scale it defines the run.
design.draftText: ×1.15 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract

critic.concerns: Differs from ub-contract-trick-xmult only in amount (acknowledged), and ×1.15 per contract trick is an exponent players can't price in their heads.
